item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00165","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C09","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 is an almost exact person-specific drafting template issued less than a month earlier. It reproduces the child's two-recital structure, cites the identical retirement statute and presidential authority, and uses the same operative exemption for an indefinite period; only the individual, position, and relevant month differ. C09 and C12 use substantially the same machinery, but C09 varies the first recital and C12 grants a fixed one-year exemption.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS Mr. Frederick C. Mayer ... will, during the month of March 1952, become subject to compulsory retirement for age under the provisions of the Civil Service Retirement Act of May 29, 1930, as amended unless exempted therefrom by Executive order","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS Frances Perkins ... will, during the month of April 1952 become subject to compulsory retirement for age under the provisions of the Civil Service Retirement Act of May 29, 1930, as amended, unless exempted therefrom by Executive order","explanation":"The opening recital has the same syntax and legal predicate, with only the person, office, and month changed."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that the said person be exempted from such compulsory retirement as provided below","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that the said person be exempted from such compulsory retirement as provided below","explanation":"The second recital is verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 404 (5 U.S.C. 715a), I hereby exempt the said Frederick C. Mayer from compulsory retirement for age for an indefinite period of time.","parent_excerpt":"NOW THEREFORE, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 404 (5 U.S.C. 715a), I hereby exempt the said Frances Perkins from compulsory retirement for age for an indefinite period of time.","explanation":"The authority clause, operative action, and indefinite duration are materially identical; the named beneficiary is the only substantive substitution."}]}
